title: Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token
abstract: arXiv:2611.06837v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive rollouts, each revealing only one realization. We ask whether the activations produced while reading the context can directly forecast the model's rollout activations. We train context--answer metamodels that map a context activation sequence to point or distribution forecasts of mean-pooled answer activations. We find that (i) the four metamodel families we study forecast mean-pooled answer activations with high fidelity, and the distribution metamodels also capture rollout variability; (ii) performance improves as the training set grows to 500,000 prompts, and the metamodels generalize zero-shot to out-of-domain datasets; (iii) their forecasts retain behavior-predictive signal; and (iv) context activations from Qwen2.5 predict mean-pooled answer activations

translated_title: 上下文-答案元模型：在首个答案词元生成之前预测大语言模型激活
translated_abstract: 在随机解码条件下，单个上下文可以从语言模型中引出许多不同的答案。表征这种变化通常需要大量昂贵的自回归推演，而每次推演只能揭示一个实现样本。我们提出这样一个问题：模型在阅读上下文时产生的激活能否直接预测模型推演时的激活。我们训练了上下文-答案元模型，将上下文激活序列映射为平均池化答案激活的点预测或分布预测。我们发现：（i）我们研究的四种元模型家族能够高保真地预测平均池化的答案激活，且分布元模型还能捕捉推演过程中的变异性；（ii）随着训练集增长到50万个提示，性能不断提升，并且元模型能够零样本泛化到域外数据集；（iii）它们的预测保留了可预测模型行为的信号；（iv）来自Qwen2.5的上下文激活能够预测平均池化的答案激活。
tldr: 本文提出上下文-答案元模型，证明语言模型阅读上下文时产生的激活序列可以直接高保真地预测其在随机解码推演中产生的答案激活，且性能随训练数据增长而提升并能零样本泛化到域外数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes context-answer metamodels that can directly and faithfully forecast LLM answer activations during stochastic decoding rollouts from context-reading activations, with performance improving as training data grows to 500,000 prompts and zero-shot generalization to out-of-domain datasets.
